name: GitLab.com (API, public keys, raw files)
tier_rationale: GitLab Inc. is an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P103 cond 1 'Registry provider gitlab: tier trusted', P190 cond 6, P305 cond 1 and P359 cond 3.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for the GitLab.com accounts, groups and repositories it hosts; profile fields are self-published by the account owner (P103 cond 4); hosted datasets such as the Exploit-DB CSV are as reliable as their maintainers.

gitlab.description: GitLab.com access token (read_api; PRIVATE-TOKEN or Authorization header only, never in URLs or logs)
gitlab.plan_hint: business = a token of a company/team GitLab.com account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded in key_plans.gitlab (P305 cond 2); only blob search needs it

users_api.title: GitLab users API (users?username=, users/{id}) and public {user}.keys/.gpg

terms.quote: Registry provider gitlab: tier trusted, terms open; personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

users_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P103 cond 1); research C0238 terms 'GitLab.com ToS; public API' (verified_live 200). gitlab.com/api/v4/users?username={u} (200 with [] = ABSENT), /api/v4/users/{id}, and the plain-text gitlab.com/{u}.keys and {u}.gpg capped at 1 MB at module level, stored as SHA-256 fingerprints (P103 cond 3). public_email, linked accounts and website fields are case-bound personal data, pivots with expand=False (P103 cond 4). Used by gitlab_user, username_check and github_user (cross-platform key match, P111).

groups_api.title: GitLab groups API (top-level group search, group projects)

terms.quote: Sources: GitHub REST 'key-terms' (as P111); GitLab, Codeberg, npm, PyPI and Docker Hub 'open'.

groups_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P359 cond 3); research C0759 terms 'GitLab API terms.' (verified_live 200). gitlab.com/api/v4/groups?search={name}&top_level_only=true&per_page=20 and /api/v4/groups/{id}/projects?per_page=100&order_by=last_activity_at&simple=true. Secrets found in public history are reported masked, never tested (P359 cond 1). Used by org_code_footprint.

blob_search.title: GitLab search API scope=blobs and repository file raw (token)

terms.quote: Key-terms (legal floor): the tokens belong to company/team accounts on plans whose terms permit internal business use, recorded in the provider registry (key_plans) before the module runs under the corporate profile.

blob_search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P305 cond 2); research C0680 terms 'GitLab ToS' (unverified). gitlab.com/api/v4/search?scope=blobs&search={term}&per_page=100 and /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/files/{path}/raw?ref={ref} with the token. Raw search bodies are never cached (ttl=0 at module level) and matched fragments pass the P312 secret scanner (P305 cond 6). Merge only with trimmed real fixtures captured with the team token (P305 cond 10). Used by code_search.

exploitdb_csv.title: Exploit-DB files_exploits.csv hosted at gitlab.com/exploit-database (CVE -> public exploit)

terms.quote: Repository under GPL-2.0: download as external data at runtime, do not vendor into V3LUM

exploitdb_csv.notes: Quote: research C0435 terms (verified_live 206): gitlab.com/exploit-database/exploitdb/-/raw/main/files_exploits.csv, refreshed weekly by the dataset manager (P190 cond 1). GPL-2.0 obligations are met by runtime download and attribution (A1 'open', A6); never vendored. An Exploit-DB entry marks exploit_maturity 'weaponised' (P190 cond 3). Used by exploit_index (offline index, disclosure none).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G05-1, p1-G05-2, p2-G05-1, p2-G05-2, p2-G08-2, p2-G14-3 (P103, P111, P113, P190, P305, P359): batches only extend it (gitlab__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Shared hosting platform like core github: further datasets hosted on gitlab.com are added by gitlab__<batch>.json extensions with their own terms; self-hosted GitLab instances are target infrastructure, never this provider (P103 cond 2). Quota: GitLab.com publishes 500 requests each minute for unauthenticated traffic from an IP address (current rate limits, checked 2026-11-26) -> egress budget at 80%; 429 = could not verify (P103 cond 5). The same page lists proposed per-plan limits that are not in effect yet (unauthenticated traffic 60 each hour per IP address, announced with brownout windows): lower this block when GitLab enforces them. Token only in a header, never in URLs or logs (P305 cond 8). Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use (P103 cond 1).
